description: Gate commands, run in order by harness/scripts/verify.mjs. Equivalent to npm run check (tsc, lint, vitest, build).

knownFlakes.test: pedestrian timing test (name in CLAUDE.md QA section)
knownFlakes.action: Rerun the failing file alone: npx vitest run <file>. Report as flake only if it passes solo.

commands: rerun a flaky test alone: npx vitest run <file>
humanChecks: Visual: day and night, the touched view
Perf: no frame-time drop on the seeded city

commands: compare a seeded hash or layout key before and after where tests have one
humanChecks: Visual: one screenshot of the same view before and after, identical
Browser: app loads at the dev URL with no console errors

rules: A change of a tuned value needs its docs/TUNING.md row and a tests/tuningParity.test.ts entry.
A new file over 350 lines fails the guard; split it, do not raise the limit.
Decisions that change a rule get a new ADR under docs/adr/.

Commits, pushes and merges follow harness/config/policies.json autonomy (docs/adr/0014-delegated-delivery.md). Until T-0010 lands, human checks not done are listed as not verified and block the release to master, not the merge to dev.
